settings.lead: Everything we sell, on one page. Each piece earned its place by solving one small daily problem, and by still doing it a year later. Filter by where it lives in your home, or read the three facts under each one.
settings.empty_text: Nothing here yet. Try another filter, or write to us.

settings.title: Ships within one working day
settings.body: From our shelf in Den Haag, tracked, to most of the world. The exact cost shows at checkout before you pay.

settings.title: Thirty days to decide
settings.body: Return anything unused in its packaging. Email us your order number and we send the address; the refund goes back the way you paid.

settings.title: Two-year warranty
settings.body: If a piece chips, frays or fails in normal use, we repair or replace it. No forms, no ticket numbers, just a reply from a person.

settings.title: What does shipping cost?
settings.content: Netherlands and Belgium €4,95, free on orders over €40. Rest of Europe €9,95. Rest of the world €14,95. The exact amount is shown at checkout before you pay.

settings.title: Do you ship to my country?
settings.content: Yes, we ship worldwide with tracking. Outside the EU, import duties and local taxes are charged by your customs office and are not included in our price.

settings.title: Are the prices including VAT?
settings.content: Yes. All prices include Dutch VAT. If you order from outside the EU, VAT is removed at checkout automatically.

settings.title: Can I order several pieces in one parcel?
settings.content: Yes, orders ship together. If one piece is a few weeks from restock, we tell you before you pay so you can decide whether to wait or split the order.

settings.heading: Not sure which one?
settings.text: Write to us and say what you are after. We will tell you honestly which piece fits, or if none of them does.
